steps.code:
# Count songs per artist (each unique song counted once)
from collections import defaultdict
artist_song_count = defaultdict(int)
for sid, song in song_details.items():
    for artist in song['artists']:
        artist_song_count[artist['name']] += 1

# Sort by count ascending, then by name alphabetically for deterministic tie-breaking
sorted_artists = sorted(artist_song_count.items(), key=lambda x: (x[1], x[0]))
print("All artists sorted by count:")
for name, cnt in sorted_artists:
    print(f"{name}: {cnt}")

# Get the 4 with least songs
least_4 = [name for name, cnt in sorted_artists[:4]]
print("Least 4 artists:", least_4)
